title: Redis Cluster: every key hashes to one of 16 384 slots, each slot to one primary
caption: The client computes the slot itself and talks to the right primary directly; replicas take over if a primary fails.

steps.text: slot = CRC16(key) mod 16384. For {user42}:cart only the part in braces is hashed, so all of user 42's keys share one slot.
The client caches the slot → node map and sends each command straight to the owner. A wrong guess gets a MOVED reply with the new owner.
Each primary streams its writes to a replica. If a primary fails, its replica is promoted and takes over the same slots.
Scaling out means moving whole slots to a new primary. A single key never splits, so one viral key still lands on one node.
